note: Calibration set, not a CI oracle. scanner_signals are machine-checked by check_fixtures.py; labels and must_mention are a human/agent checklist.

cases.name: renders the fixed name
cases.label: WEAK
cases.reason: Single literal value; hardcoding the prop value still passes. It proves text exists, not that the prop is used.

cases.name: renders two different names
cases.label: STRONG
cases.reason: Two inputs, two assertions; catches a component that ignores the prop.

cases.name: calls onSelect when clicked
cases.label: WEAK
cases.reason: Only asserts the spy was called; no argument, visible state, or outcome.

cases.name: matches the snapshot
cases.label: BRITTLE
cases.reason: Snapshot is the only assertion; it changes for refactors and can be re-blessed.

cases.name: is self-consistent
cases.label: FAKE
cases.reason: Both sides call formatPrice; the test moves with the bug.

cases.name: formats a hand-computed value
cases.label: STRONG
cases.reason: Independent expected value; catches a changed formatter.

cases.name: test_silver_discount_is_hand_computed
cases.label: STRONG
cases.reason: Hand-computed pricing rule; catches a changed rate.

cases.name: test_discount_is_self_consistent
cases.label: FAKE
cases.reason: Same call on both sides; a pricing bug still passes.

cases.name: test_unknown_tier_raises
cases.label: STRONG
cases.reason: Asserts the documented error contract for an invalid tier.

cases.name: test_invalid_int_raises
cases.label: STRONG
cases.reason: Asserts the error path with pytest.raises.

cases.name: test_invalid_int_is_swallowed
cases.label: WEAK
cases.reason: Narrow `except ValueError` does not catch the AssertionError, so the test can still go red; it duplicates pytest.raises with a worse failure message.

cases.name: test_invalid_int_hides_assertion
cases.label: FAKE
cases.reason: `except Exception` catches the AssertionError and passes; the test cannot go red.

cases.name: test_create_calls_repo
cases.label: WEAK
cases.reason: Only asserts the mock was called; no payload or persisted state.

cases.name: test_create_persists_user
cases.label: STRONG
cases.reason: Uses a fake repo and asserts the stored row and returned value.

cases.name: test_create_does_not_raise
cases.label: WEAK
cases.reason: Only checks that creation does not crash; it does not check what was created.
